༄༅// dpal kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa smin grol dngos grub rab 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo pha bla ma rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tshar pa chen po gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mchog gi sprul sku byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' nam mkha' legs pa lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bka' drin mtshungs zla med pa'i zhal snga nas dang*/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyis pa rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i rgyal tshab mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa thar rtse ba chen po byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med mchog dpon slob brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zhabs la rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rang gzhan smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dir gsung ngag nyams len gyi snying po dpal kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len nag 'gros su dgod pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i gdams ngag bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa las dang po pas phyi dkyil dang sbrags te sgom pa ston pa ni/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas 'bring gnyis gang yang rung bas dam tshig pa bskyed ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs pa la mchod cing bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai tā lī bhan+dha bam̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa sham̐ ku ru hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/

ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re khā ste rtsig pa lnga/ sna rin po che'i pha gu/ so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba'i am̐/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i hā/ phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐/ zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte ba'i ham̐/ gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gtso bo lnga po thams cad dbu'i gtsug tor lta bar mi mngon pa la sogs pa'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs pa'i dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/

dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de dag mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis mig tu gzugs gau rī/ rna bar sgra tsau rī/ snar dri bai tā lī/ lcer ro ghasma rī/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying gar chos khams mkha' spyod ma/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// lag pa g.yas par gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin la/ lag pa g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yon par stobs po che nag po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur pa ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de dag thams cad kyang sku'i dbyibs/ rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal stong*/ ngo bo zung 'jug gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi skur gyur/ zhes brjod do// de nas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs par bsam ste/ gtso bo de nyid rang la rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba'i bla mar mos te/ de'i mdun du bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams kyang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/

cho ga spod pa rnams ni bla mas mdzad la/ dbang rdzas 'grim pa rnams ni de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i las kyi rdo rje phyag gnyis pas mdzad par bsam mo// ngag tu/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags zhes pa nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pa'i bar lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ces sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ zhes dang*/ 'di la bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga las/ swa bhā was/ bdag gi lus kyi sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung pos gtsor byas pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dang*/ zhes dang*/ de la mchan 'di ltar mdzad de/ rig pa'i dbang sogs kyi skabs su rang gi sbyang gzhi gtso bo rnams smos nas stong par sbyong ba bdag gi bla ma'i gsung ste shin tu zab bo// 'di ltar gsungs shing*/

de bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi gsung ngag nang dkyil zin dris las/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi tshe swa bhā was/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas mi bskyod pa zhes sogs dkyus bzhin te mdor na rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pa'i bar du lus dkyil rnams rigs lnga rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje 'chang rnams rim bzhin bskyed nas dbang len pa lam dus kyi zab gnad shin tu gces pa yin gsungs/ rnam snang rdor sems gnyis la zla gdan byed pa dgra nag sogs kyi bzhed pa yin mod/ gzhung bshad rnams su nyi gdan bshad pas de bzhin bya zhing rdo rje 'chang sngon por byed pa 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhed pa yin na'ang*/ 'dir rgyu lam gnyis ka la rgyu rdo rje 'chang yin pas dkar po bya/ de ltar dbang bzhi dkyus bzhin rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan pa'i bar blangs rjes mdun gyi dbang lha rang la bstim/ zhes gsungs pa'i slob bshad pa'i bla ma gong ma de dag gi zhal rgyun nag 'gros su bkod par bdag chen rin po che'i gsung khag bris/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsung mtshal bris byas pa lags/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi lus kyi sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung pos gtsor byas pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dang*/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis gsung rgyun/ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs dang*/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes sogs brjod cing*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/

lus thams cad gang bas mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ 'di bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang bsam mo/ /lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces brjod do// dbang rdzas kyi yan lag bzhi rdzogs ni 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi lus kyi sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung pos gtsor byas pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dang*/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du am̐ las rin po che ser po am̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlan gnyis gsung rgyun/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/

sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// nas/ rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ badz+ra ra ga ta badz+ra sha le hoḥ gsung rgyun/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

bum dbang bdun po re re la'ang chu rgyun gcig la dbang bzhi bskur ba/ dga' ston la gdams par gsungs/ 'di phyi dkyil du dbang bskur ba las zab pa'i phyir ro// zhes bdag chen rin po ches gsungs/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi lus kyi sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung pos gtsor byas pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dang*/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dmar po dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis gsung rgyun/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku gang*/

dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi lus kyi sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung pos gtsor byas pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dang*/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kham̐ las ral gri ljang gu kham̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis gsung rgyun/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa dhi s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pa'i dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi lus kyi sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung pos gtsor byas pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dang*/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba// gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha// chos rnams rang bzhin rnam par dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi sbyang gzhi chos can phung po lnga'i chos nyid dbyings kyi cha 'jig rten pa'i dri ma dang bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi chos can phung po lnga'i chos nyid dbyings kyi cha lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bum pa'i dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod do// de nas/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang*// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol bar btab/ de nas rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du rdo rje sems dpa' gnas pa'i lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin par bsams la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka s+t+waṃ dhā ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje snying gar bzung bar mos te/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag

/bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas la'o// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ lag pa g.yon par dril bu sbyin par bsams la/ kye dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i sgra yin no// 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyings kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// āḥ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra ghan+ḍe āḥ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rje byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor bar// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod// srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*// sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis long*// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du// rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bgyi// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su bshad// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes brjod/

de nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ gsung rgyun/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang bas mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbur brgyan/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ bar/ de ltar na bdag nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa kun gyis/ zhes brjod dgos pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsungs/ bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag brda lnga bsdus rtse mos mnan pa/ brda chig brgyud thob nas lus ngag yi ge'i brda rnams 'dir dran gso nyams len dgos pa'o// lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces brjod de bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes brjod/ de nas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying pa skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod de/ gdong ras bcing bar bsams la/ de nas/ bla ma he ru ka snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ thig le mgrin par thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ zhes dang*/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems phung khams skye mched kyi dwangs ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i rang bzhin de nyid mgrin par myangs pas/ gzhir gnas kyi byang chub kyi sems dam tshig pa dang*/ yas byon pa'i ye shes pa rnams gnyis su med par 'dres/ lus kyi nang thams cad byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'gag

phyi he ru ka lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rgyud la gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ gsung rnam par dag pa 'od dpag med kyi ngo bor gyur par mos la/ a ho ma hā su kha/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod de gdong ras bsal bar bsam mo// de ltar na bdag nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa kun gyis/

zhes brjod dgos pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsungs/ rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag brda mtheb srin gyi e la reg byed gcig brda chig brgyud thob nas lus ngag yi ge'i brda rnams 'dir dran gso nyams len dgos pa'o// lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces brjod de/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba nas/ brlab tu gsol/ bar gong ltar/ de nas bstod pa dang*/ gsol btab gsang dbang ltar byas la/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod de gdong ras bcing bar bsam/ de nas bla mas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes gsungs nas rig ma sbyin par bsams la/ de nas rig ma des/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed par// khyod ni ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes dris pa'i lan du/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par cis mi spro// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed pa// bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to// de nas rig ma des/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// s+t+waṃ pad+ma bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ

zhes gsungs nas pang du byon par bsam/ de nas/ rig ma de bdag med mar gsal ba'i mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ bdag nyid kyai rdor gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par bsams nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i gtum mo'i mes spyi bo'i haṃ bzhu nas/ de las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar slebs pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor mthar thug par slebs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slar yang rlung gi nus pas yar drangs te/ gsang gnas nas lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ spyi bor slebs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ gdong ras phye bar bsam/ de ltar na bdag nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa kun gyis/ zhes brjod dgos pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsungs/ phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ brda chig brgyud thob nas lus ngag yi ge'i brda rnams 'dir dran gso nyams len dgos pa'o// lam pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces brjod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngau*// de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rje nas/ gsol/ de nas/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas// dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod de/ gdong ras bcing par bsam/ de nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes brjod de zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /zhes snang*/ de'i don yang dngos po'i gnas lugs bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di mngon sum du ma rtogs par bla na med pa'i byang chub mi thob pas/ mngon sum rtogs par bya dgos la/ ji ltar rtogs pa'i thabs kyang phyi rol gyi dpe brtags dang*/ slob dpon gyi ngag tu brjod pa las rtogs par mi nus pas/ rang gi sems la ye shes skyed dgos shing*/ de nyid mngon du byed pa'i tshul yang*/ dbang gsum pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes nyams su myong ba dang*/ sems chos nyid nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med pa ste/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba la yid rtog med du bzhag de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam mo// de ltar na bdag nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa kun gyis/ zhes brjod dgos pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsungs/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag brda mdzub mo'i nam mkha' mtshon pa/ brda chig brgyud thob nas lus ngag yi ge'i brda rnams 'dir dran gso nyams len dgos pa'o// lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces brjod de dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod de/ de nas/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/

bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas nam mkha'i dbang lha rang la bstim/ de nas bdud rtsi myong ba sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// ༈ /dbang 'bring du len par 'dod na/ mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa yan chad gong bzhin byas la/ de nas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes pas/ bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// zhes pas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhes sogs gong ltar ro// dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes pas/ phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhes sogs gong ltar ro// ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pas/

don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ zhes sogs gong ltar ro// ༈ /dbang bsdus pa len par 'dod na thog mar gsol gdab/ mchod pa snga ma dang 'dra bar byas la sgrub thabs su bstan pa ltar/ dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig la len par bya'o// de la thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byed par 'dod pas/ grub na thun bzhi ka la dbang rgyas par blang*/ de tsam mi grub na/ thun thog mtha' gnyis rgyas par blang zhing bar pa gnyis 'bring du blangs pas btub bo// bsdus pa 'di ni nad pa lta bur dbang rgyas par len pa ye ma lcogs na bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan du bya ba ma yin no// zhes pa 'di ni lam 'di la gtso bor byed pa'i las dang po pa rnams kyi don du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par blangs pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis e wam̐ chos ldan du bris pa'o// 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol gyi/ gang zag so sos 'di la bri bsnan ma byed cig mdo rgyud rin chen 'byung khungs legs 'ongs pa'i// snyan brgyud gsung ngag bsam 'phel rin po che// 'khrul med ded dpon rnams las brgyud pa 'di// gang gi rnyed nas snying gi rgyal mtshan rtser// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mchog gis gsol 'debs pa'i// skal bzang gang na bzhugs pa thams cad la// spyi bor thal sbyor snying nas rjes yi rangs// myur du 'gro ba'i dpal mgon mdzad du gsol// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /gsung ngag rin po che smin grol yongs rdzogs thob phyin chad phyi nang gi mngon rtogs lam dus kyi dbang rab thun bzhi/ 'bring thun gsum/ tha ma thun gnyis re'i nyams len ma byas na mi rung ba/ rgyud dang*/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma'i phyag len thun mong ma yin pa/ kha'u pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ lam 'bras khrid kyi snying po 'di// gnyis las gsum byung gdams ngag yin// kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i// man ngag shes pa bla ma'i drin// zhes gsung pa'i ya gyal gcig ni nye brgyud ring brgyud gnyis las byung ba'i mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi drug

bsdus pa ste gsum dang*/ de bzhin gyi dbang la dngos 'dzin mdzad de lam 'bras kyi nyams len snying po yin par gsungs so// ༈ /de'ang slob bshad kyi sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi zin bris las byung ba'i/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ni/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring drug pa/ bsdus pa ni sngon 'gro skyabs sems kyi rjes su gzhan med par/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ ye shes tshogs bsag byas/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du lha so so'i gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du gsal ba'i/ zhes pa'i bar lam gyis bsgoms pas chog gi re re nas gsal 'debs mi dgos/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs man chad dkyus bzhin la/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs don dran bzhin pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum brjod pas rung gsung*/ dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ni dkyus ltar/ 'bring po'i tshe rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje brtul zhugs dang drug dam tshig gsum dang bcas pa thob byung snyam pa'i nges shes/ gsang dbang gi tshe bdud rtsi lce la myangs/ lus khengs pa dang*/ gsum pa'i tshe dri ba dri lan sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par zhugs dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu skyes byung snyam pa'i nges shes yid ches pa re skye dgos gsung*/ bzhi pa'i tshe mtshon bya don gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes yod na/ 'das pa'i rtog pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da ltar gyi rig pa skad cig ma la dbang bzhi tshang ba yin/ gsal ba'i cha bum dbang*/ stong pa'i cha gsang dbang*/ dbyer med pa gsum pa/ de'i ngo bo blo 'das bzhi pa ste/ mdor na/ chu la sogs pas rab bkrus bzhin// zhes gsung pa bzhin dbang gi chu bo rab ye shes/

'bring nges shes/ tha ma tshig la bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ ye shes rgyud la skyes na legs/ ma skyes kyang dbang de dang de thob/ dri ma de dang de dag thob bya de dang de mngon du byas pa yin snyam pa'i nges shes ma skyes na/ bshar sbyang tsam nges don gyi chu bo nub 'gro bas nan tan cher bya gsung*// ༈ /yang tshogs slob smra ba'i nyi ma paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsung las byung ba'i 'bring po ni/ mngon rtogs 'bring po sngon du btang nas dbang len na/ skyabs sems nas rigs lnga'i sdom gzung gi bar rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin bya ba bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gi bzhed pa de bzhin du byas na legs/ de nas/ shū n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thun mong ba'i srung 'khor dkyus bzhin dang*/ de'i nang du e las chos 'byung gru gsum yangs pa'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa nang nas rim pa bzhin du zhes pa nas/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ zhes pa'i bar ngag 'don dkyus bzhin bya/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag tu shing chen po brgyad/ ces pa nas/ thags zangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur gyi bar maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod skabs dang 'dra/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nī la ya sogs brjod/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ yum bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te sogs mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ sngags brjod mi dgos/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/

yab kyi zhal du zhugs pa nas/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum zhes sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bar snang nas zhes pa nas/ bcud kyi sems can la phog pas lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bar rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin brjod/ lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ gau rī la sogs sngags rgyas bstim/ lus dkyil gsal gdab/ dbang lha spyan drangs// ༈ /dbang 'bring po ni/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab sngar bzhin dang*/ dbang dngos la rigs dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs dang drug dor nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs nas/ tshig gsum sbyin pa nas/ bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhes sogs/ rtogs bskyed bar dkyus bzhin/ gsang dbang ni/ dbang lha'i gtso bo bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang dang lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi ljags thog tu gnang ste/ ji ltar 'das pa'i tshigs bcad gsung bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su rang gis brjod/ bsgom don ni/ byang chub kyi sems rang gi mgrin pa nas song ste/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas dus gsum las gyur pa'i rtog pa thams cad 'gag ste/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam/ rtogs bskyed ni/ rang nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhes sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ sher dbang ni bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i sku'i cha las/ mtshan ldan gyi rten phun sum tshogs pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa gcig rang la gnang ste/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo tshigs bcad gsung bar bsam zhing dngos su rang gis brjod/

bsgom don ni/ rang nyid kyai rdo rje dang*/ mtshan ldan rig ma de nyid bdag med mar bsgom/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs dkyus bzhin bya zhing*/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rang nyid kyai rdo rje yab yum dang lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi rgyud la dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes par bsam/ rtogs bskyed ni/ rang nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa kun gyis phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhes pa nas/ chos sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par brjod de/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ gtso bo'i zhal nas/ ye shes 'di ni sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsung bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su rang gis brjod/ bsgom don ni/ dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa de'i ngo bo la cher bltas pas/ gang du'ang ma grub cing*/ skye 'gag la sogs pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu'i ngang du cung zad bzhag rtogs bskyed ni/ rang nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa kun gyis/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhes pa nas/ ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes brjod/ de ltar dbang bzhi blang ba'i dus su phung khams skyed mched lha dang ye shes su shes pa bskyed rim gyi sdom pa thob/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi brten pa rang rig pa dbyings dang rig pa gnyis su med pa bde stong mchog gi ye shes su ngo shes pa rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa thob snyam du dran no// gtso bos ji ltar dang*/ maṇ+ḍal sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o// de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad ces pa nas/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa dang*/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod/ dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba rnams rang la thim par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis bdud rtsi byin rlabs byas nas/

bdud rtsi myong zhing sngags brjod/ mchod pa don yod grub pa dang*/ bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin bya/ de nas gtum mo yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmigs pa bsgom pa'am/ 'bring po'i skabs yin pas ma bsgom kyang rung*/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// zhes sogs dag dran dang*/ de nas bzlas pa nas bzung bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar dkyus bzhin bya// ༈ /lus dkyil shin tu bsdus pa ni/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis zhes sogs lus dkyil dkyus bzhin nam/ yang na rten gzhal yas khang la 'bri bsnan med kyang*/ brten pa lha la lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum/ lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba thams cad ser po/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lor bcom ldan 'das phrin las don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs sku mdog ljang gu/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying gar bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i lha tshogs sku mdog sngon po/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin par bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs sku mdog dmar po/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bor bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs sku mdog dkar po/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ mig la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su yul dang yul can gyi lha mo bcu gnyis/ tshigs chen bcur khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i rten dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhi rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ ces brjod/ lus dkyil rgyas par bsgom shes pa gcig gis bsdus pa 'di tsam gyis kyang don tshang ba yin no// dbang bsdus 'bring gang len kyang sngon du lus dkyil 'di tsam bsgoms kyang chog/ ༈ /phreng ba byin rlabs tshar chen rin po che'i gsung las/ swa bhā was sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las lag pa g.yon pa pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i ze'u 'bru la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su a yig gi mthar dbyangs yig g.yon skor du bskor bar bsam/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig gi mthar gsal byed kā li g.yas skor du bskor bar bsam/ de gnyis kyi bar du bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin suṃ yig dkar po'i dbus su oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ zla nyi la sogs pa'i thabs shes kyi ngo bo de rnams snyoms par zhugs shing*/ yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer dkar po grangs med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ā li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs nas suṃ yig 'bru gsum dang bcas pa la thim/ nyi zla la sogs pa thabs shes kyi ngo bo de rnams rim bzhin du 'od du zhu nas suṃ yig la thim/ de 'bru gsum la thim pas oṃ las mdud 'dzin chos sku'i ngo bo/ āḥlas phreng rdog rnams dgra bcom pa'i rang bzhin/ hūm̐ las phreng thag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bor bgrang ba tsam gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad thogs med du bsgrub pa'i nus can du gyur/ ces brjod nas/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dz+nyā na sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha we te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa 'di bdun yan chad bzlas na/ phreng ba de la gang bzlas pa'i sngags 'bum 'gyur du 'gro bar gsungs/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra wa ra dha na ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas/ phreng ba'i mdud 'dzin la ha btab pas bzlas pa 'bum 'gyur du 'gro bar bshad/ thal sbyar bar phreng ba bcug gnas gsum lce la reg hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/

oṃ badz+ra dzai ho zhes brjod/ bdag gi bla mas gsungs so// da ni de dag las 'phros pa'i zhal gyi 'phros don ni/ bdag gis 'di ltar bsgrigs pa blo bzo dgos med rang mi 'gro snyam ste/ gsung ngag thob nas lam dus thun grangs ma byas mi 'thus la/ de yang chos ldan bya ba mang po sne 'doms tshe rgyas 'bring gi rnam dbye yang mkho gal dang*/ cha lag phreng ba byin rlabs/ mngon rtogs lam dus rgyas pa'i zhal skong nag 'gros byas kyang*/ spyir sngags kyi chog bsgrig skor la dang thog ni/ sngags chos kyi rtsa che rigs zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa las yi ge med cing*/ rjes su rim par bkod pa dag kyang*/ don thob gtso bor ston pa'i dbang gis bsnyel gso lta bus zhib gsal med pa yig rnying thams cad zhal mi gsal ba lta bur bzhugs pa ltar mngon rtogs lam dus kyi rigs kyang rje sa skya pa sku mched dang*/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas mus chen yan gnang tshod dang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos de las cung zad gsal tsam bkral ba'i gsung bya bral ma 'di bzhin dang*/ de la yang bskyar thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa mdzes rgyan rnams te/ don du bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs dpyis phyin par chod pa'i dam pa rnams la tshig ris mang nyung gsal min la mi ltos par don thob gtso bor gyur pas/ tshogs byings khrid sogs ma thob par zab gnad ston du mi btub pa'i dbang gis rang re bya bral ma dkyus ltar sor bzhag gnang ba'ang*/ bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang dngos de rnams ni bsgom byar sgro 'dogs chod cing bsgom don dmigs thog tu khel bas tshig ris la mi ltos/ slob bu mchog rnams kyang zab khrid kyi tshe snyan brgyud zhal shes yig cha las gong smos bzhin gsal bar nges shes 'phrod pas de de bzhin gyur/ tshogs mang dkyus khrid ma thob pa dag la ni/

zab gnad sbyar nas 'don rgyu mi 'ong ba/ gang zag thun mong tshogs byings kyi dbang du mdzad mod kyi/ de yang sngon gyi phyag rgyun bzhin gang zag thun mong thun min gyi ngo skal zhar las 'byed 'gro ba las/ 'di 'dra yod med mi 'dug kyang*/ rmongs rgan bdag lta bu'i rigs kyis drin chen rdo rje 'chang las man ngag thob kyang 'khrul rtog rgod drags ting nge 'dzin rnal ma mi skye bas na rang bzhin dmigs gnad zam lus gyur na/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis dbang gi chu bo/ rab ye shes/ 'bring nges shes/ tha ma tshig tsam zhes gsungs par ye shes ga la skye yang*/ nges shes shar ba'i rgyu dang tshig don chad lhag mi 'gyur ba'i dgos nges kyang 'gro snyam ste/ gnad 'di la dgongs te thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas lus dkyil mdzes rgyan sbyar byang las kyang*/ blo mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyis rje mus chen gyis mdzad pa'i lam dus kyi yi ge nyid la gzigs rtogs mdzad pa zhu lags/ zhes gsungs pa gang zag ting nge 'dzin rtsal rno rtul la dgongs par mngon no// lhag par dmigs bsal gyi rkyen bskang skor gyi dpes bkras chos su phul ba de skor lam dus kyi thad las 'phros te bla mtshan lags nas tshogs slob skor gyi bka' 'dri kha shas phebs gras dri gzhi lam dus skor dang*/ lam dus da lta ngor lugs dang tshar pa'i ngag 'don dkyus la yongs grags la/ khyad chos bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bzhag byings zab khrid las gzhung nas 'byung ba dang lam dus rang gi ngo skal dmigs bsal cung zad ni 'di bzhin 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan zhu ba'i ched du/ chu lug nag zla 'di la rje btsun sgro lung pa chen po'i sprul pa'i zlos gar 'dren mchog bla ma dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug gis lhun grub steng gi dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa kha shas la gsung ngag slob bshad kyi khrid tsam stsal zhing*/

de dag gis kyang nyams khrid don mthong gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes yod kyang*/ de dag gi zhal 'don ni chos grwa chen po 'dir mdzes rgyan thog nas gnas pa 'di la tshig tshogs phra mo'am 'bod phyogs las don du ma mthun pa tshig rigs til tsam med cing*/ dmigs bsal zab khrid skabs thos pa bzhin du thugs nges pa las zhal 'don yig cha brje nges par ma dgos mod/ 'on kyang wā gin+d+ra bha dra sogs tshar lugs sgos kyi phyag len la mos pa che ba'i re skong dang*/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos kho bo la lam dus bya bral ma'i thog nas nges par thongs zhes bka' rjes gsal phebs kyang rmongs rgan ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal rgyugs pas tshig tsam gyis dbang gi chu bo mi chad pa'i dran gsos bcas drin can rdo rje 'chang gi zhal rgyun gtsos rang lugs kha'u pa'i bla ma gong ma'i dgongs don ltar bklag chog tu bkod pa ni/ pha rgan rigs kun bdag po gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa chen po'i skye ba'i phreng bar rjes su bzung ba'i bka' drin las snyan brgyud slob bshad la byed pa rgyu mthun bag chags rang byung du brtas pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa rgyal rigs āḥming gis rang gzhan gsung ngag nyams khrid skyong ba rnams kyi kha ton nyams len du sbyar ba 'dis kyang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bstan rgyun srid mtha'i bar du 'phel rgyas brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
